Listed offers are not proof that checkout, payment, or fulfillment has completed; verify each order.

## Machine-to-machine APIs
BMT's own POST /api/v1/intel/company path is reserved and currently returns HTTP 503 API_NOT_ENABLED. It does not return mock records or initiate a charge.

The existing NOVA production deployment contains x402-protected machine API routes:
- Company intelligence: POST https://nova-demand-worker.vercel.app/x402/company-intelligence — code-default price USD 0.25 per request; one public website URL.
- Contact batch: POST https://nova-demand-worker.vercel.app/x402/contact-batch — code-default price USD 0.50 per request for 1–100 public website URLs.
- Web research: POST https://nova-demand-worker.vercel.app/x402/web-research — code-default price USD 0.05 per request for up to 10 URLs.
- URL-to-JSON: POST https://nova-demand-worker.vercel.app/x402/url-to-json — code-default price USD 0.01 per request.

These prices come from NOVA source code and may be overridden by deployment environment variables. The live x402 payment challenge is authoritative. Use an x402-capable client, inspect amount/network/asset before signing, and verify the returned result. This documentation does not claim that a live payment or external settlement was completed.

## Revenue-proof boundary
A route, catalog entry, 402 challenge, or successful build is not revenue proof. Revenue proof requires an independent buyer, execution and delivery, payment, and independently verifiable settlement.
